title: AskChem: Claim-Centered Infrastructure for Chemistry Literature Synthesis

extra.description: Chemistry literature synthesis often requires assembling specific findings scattered across many publications, yet existing literature-search systems primarily return ranked document lists. As a result, scientists and AI agents need to locate relevant information, verify their provenance, and assemble cross-paper answers manually.
